title: Diagonal obstruction to fixed-volume all-power locality
question: Does the R-562 threshold N_k(f)=max(2,s_f+2k+1) admit one fixed finite n that is beyond the locality frontier for every generator power k?

fixed_scope.model: Exactly PAH-001, the PAH-OMC-013 full-Q grade-blind cylinder algebra and the frozen OMC-004 two-row strip; no functional, rate, state, carrier, root family, projection or time change.
fixed_scope.radius: The OMC-013 root catalog has the R-562 source-derived radius r=2.
fixed_scope.threshold: For every nonconstant finite-support cylinder with support maximum s_f>=0, N_k(f)=max(2,s_f+2k+1).
fixed_scope.diagonal_witness: For every finite n, k=n+1 satisfies n<N_k(f), so no fixed n is beyond the envelope for all k.
fixed_scope.comparison: The original pointwise pullback I_(n,n+1) and the same finite backward generators used by R-493/R-562.
fixed_scope.time: The original external stochastic Markov time remains unchanged.
fixed_scope.order: This is a route-local quantifier obstruction only. No exponential series, j limit, anchored-n limit or R-512 identification is evaluated.

exact_statement: For every support maximum s_f>=0 and every finite n, there exists k (indeed k=n+1) with n<N_k(f). Equivalently sup_k N_k(f)=infinity and no fixed finite n can satisfy n>=N_k(f) for every k.
route_consequence: The R-562 fixed-k conditional identity cannot, by itself, be promoted to an all-power identity at one fixed volume and then summed termwise into an exponential semigroup. A separate uniform word/factorial tail, cancellation estimate, or common-process argument is required.

finite_checks.source_radius: The primary lane re-derives the R-562 radius from the frozen OMC-013 catalog at levels 2 through 9.
finite_checks.diagonal_samples: Representative supports s_f in {0,1,4,10} and finite levels n in {2,3,5,11} are checked with k=n+1.
finite_checks.lean: Lean proves the universal diagonal witness, unbounded threshold and no-uniform-eventuality statements over Nat.

decision_rule.NEGATIVE_RESULT: Use only for the route-local proposition that R-562's fixed-k threshold cannot supply a fixed-n all-power premise.
decision_rule.HOLD_FOR_EVIDENCE: Keep PAH-OMC-020 open because the full semigroup could still be established by an independent uniform tail, cancellation, common realization or path/form route.
decision_rule.MAINLINE_ADVANCE: Not available from this arithmetic obstruction; no active gate or claim tier changes.

missing_assumptions: A uniform-in-k connected-word or factorial tail in the unchanged Markov time.
A source-authorized common U_n or path-space realization compatible with all powers.
N2b liminf/recovery, N2c/N4 boundary escape and N2d R-512 minimal-form identification.
non_claims: This is not a no-go theorem for the PAH stationary semigroup or for all possible convergence proofs.
It does not refute exponential convergence if an independent uniform estimate or cancellation is supplied.
It does not prove infinite-volume dynamics, ordered j-before-n convergence or R-512 equality.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, gravity, continuum, mass-gap, Yang--Mills or TOE conclusion follows.
